correctness.rationale: The displayed quartic satisfies \(s_{n+1}-s_n=2P(n)\); this identity was independently expanded symbolically from the audited coefficients. Defining the stated endpoint quantity \(H_n\), substitution of the three-term recurrence makes the mixed coefficient equal to \(c n^r(-2P(n)+s_{n+1}-s_n)=0\), while the remaining square coefficient is exactly \(W_n\). The \(n=0\) boundary follows from \(u_1=P(0)u_0\), \(s_0=0\), \(s_1=2P(0)\). Telescoping therefore proves the identity for every \(N\ge1\), every integer \(r\ge1\), \(c\ne0\), and every cubic-or-lower \(P\).
